map.label: Smart Retail Intelligence Network
map.desc: An AI/ML system that forecasts demand per product per day, flags stock that is expiring, dead or losing shelf presence, catches demand hikes early, makes the supply chain transparent, and turns all of it into clear daily actions for store workers and managers.
details: Base repo: Smart Retail Precision Demand Forecasting & Dynamic Pricing Engine (Python, pandas, LightGBM, SciPy)
Unit of analysis: one SKU x one store x one day
North-star outcome: less waste, fewer stockouts, healthier margin, less guesswork for workers
map.prompt: You are helping build the Smart Retail Intelligence Network: a Python AI/ML system that forecasts SKU-day demand, detects expiry risk, dead stock, weak shelf presence and demand spikes, scores supplier transparency, compares weak SKUs against well-fulfilled peers, and outputs plain-language daily actions for retail workers. The existing repo has data_loader.py (cleaning + zero-filled daily grid), features.py (calendar, lag 1/7/14/30, rolling 7/30, price ratio), forecasting.py (WAPE + expanding-window CV with LightGBM Tweedie) and pricing_engine.py (log-log elasticity + bounded profit optimisation with a 1.15x cost floor). Keep code typed, tested with pytest, leakage-free, and explainable.
